zh: 优化日志与文本脱敏策略：复合「账号/密码」写法及带凭据 URL 仅脱敏密码部分、保留账号名（如 admin），避免误脱敏；请求日志同时保留 input_tokens、output_tokens 等模型用量统计字段。
en: Refined redaction for logs and prompts: compound account/password strings and credentialed URLs now preserve the username while redacting only the password, and request logs preserve model token-usage fields such as input_tokens and output_tokens.
